obligations.source_text: Create one independent, randomized, complex photographic test scene for the arm-assigned vibraphone meaning, use the attachment only for bounded visible adult appearance cues, render the image, and judge whether the instrument semantics are actually visible in the pixels.

bindings.metal_bar_phrase: two rows of graduated metal bars form the keyboard, their silvery alloy surfaces catching clean highlights
bindings.resonator_fan_phrase: vertical resonator tubes show fan or rotor assemblies beneath the bars, with circular disks visibly aligned inside multiple open tube mouths
bindings.pedal_phrase: a damper pedal connects to the wheeled frame and sits visibly under the performer's pressing right foot
bindings.mallet_pedal_phrase: mallets contact the metal bars while one foot controls the pedal in a single physically playable downbeat
bindings.xylophone_confound_phrase: wooden bars without motor fans and a pedal do not substitute; the pictured instrument reads through positive metal-bar, rotor, and damping-hardware evidence
